Tatsuya Hasome (Japanese: 羽染達也 Hasome Tatsuya) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hasome was born on May 15, 1989, in , . He became a voice actor as an adult, but only got very few roles in anime series, and was affiliated with the talent agency tristone. Hasome provided his voice for during of .
